items.title: 'There was some really fair criticism': Arc Raiders' devs understand why players were so upset about its AI use but say that it was 'too impractical to record' every voice line
items.excerpt: Embark executive producer Aleksander Grøndal says criticism of Arc Raiders' AI text-to-speech voices was 'really fair' but recording every line was 'too impractical'; the studio has since re-recorded lines to add more real human voices.

items.title: 'I drank from the chalice of blood': indie dev scrubs his game of AI-generated voice lines, having previously described the technology as 'anti-human and anti-art'
items.excerpt: Paolo Pedercini (Molleindustria) removed several AI-generated text-to-speech voice lines from his ecosocialist satire Future? No Thanks! after backlash over undisclosed genAI use (TTS voices and Suno music loops).

items.title: The 50 most-played Steam Next Fest demos include 7 incremental games, 4 AI disclosures, and only one instance of haystack slop
items.excerpt: Valve's list of the 50 most-played demos from an 8,000-demo Steam Next Fest shows only four declaring generative AI use, suggesting players are largely passing over overt genAI games.

items.title: 'VRChat' Faces User Backlash After Rejecting 'AI-Generated' Content Label
items.excerpt: VRChat is facing a sizable user backlash after deciding not to label AI-generated content, following a survey earlier this month asking users whether the social VR platform should.

items.title: Nearly 50 percent of all of last month's Steam releases admit to containing AI slop
items.excerpt: An analysis of Steam release data posted to r/Steam finds 49.9% of games released in October 2026 disclosed AI-generated content, up from 26.4% a year earlier and 1.7% when the disclosure field launched in January 2024.

items.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 In Mario Kart World Shows A Glimpse Of The Future, As Nintendo Switch 2 Emulated Game Looks Almost Like An Animated Movie
items.excerpt: An emulated Mario Kart World running on PC with NVIDIA DLSS 5 neural rendering looks close to an animated film, previewing how neural rendering can restyle a game's art direction.

items.title: Phantom Blade Zero Has Been Out For Less Than 1 Day, Yet First Mods Adding NVIDIA DLSS 5 Support and Gameplay Tweaks Have Already Dropped
items.excerpt: Within a day of Phantom Blade Zero's PC launch, modders injected NVIDIA DLSS 5 neural rendering support alongside difficulty-tuning tweaks.

items.title: 크래프톤, K팝 AI 챗 키프 국내 서비스 시작
items.excerpt: 크래프톤이 K팝 AI 캐릭터 챗 '키프(Kiff)'를 국내 출시했다. 피프티피프티가 첫 아티스트로 공식 캐릭터 '웨니'를 함께 만들었고, 대화를 기억해 반응하며 하루 대화를 그림일기로 남긴다.

items.title: AI 캐릭터로 피규어·OST까지, '디어비' 구글 플레이 정식 출시
items.excerpt: 디어비가 AI 컴패니언·AI UGC 플랫폼 '디어비(Dearbe)'를 구글 플레이에 정식 출시했다. 이용자가 AI 캐릭터와 대화하고 직접 캐릭터와 스토리를 만들어 공유하며, 피규어·OST로까지 확장한다.

items.title: 콘진원, 'AI 게임랩 데이 2026' 개최…게임 개발 AI 활용 사례 공유
items.excerpt: 콘진원이 11월 12일 판교에서 'AI 게임랩 데이 2026'을 열어 송재경 등 개발자의 AI 활용 게임 제작·엔진 사례 강연과 중소 게임사 대상 일대일 기술 상담을 진행한다.

items.title: 게임제작 AI 전환 성과 공유, 게임 데이즈 2026 11월 개최
items.excerpt: 콘진원 주최 '게임 데이즈 2026'이 11월 9~10일 열려 게임 제작의 AI 전환 성과를 공유한다.

items.title: 'AI 흔적 글이 스팀 상위권에 자주 오른다' 연구 결과 발표
items.excerpt: 연구 스튜디오 크리트필드가 346개 게임의 스팀 영어 리뷰 65만여 건을 분석한 결과, 최근 1년간 스팀 게임 3개 중 1개에서 챗봇 흔적이 있는 리뷰가 '가장 유용한 리뷰' 상위 10위에 올랐다. 다만 전체 리뷰의 약 1%라 평점 영향은 미미했다.

items.title: Introducing the official Unity plugin for Antigravity
items.excerpt: Unity's official plugin is now live in Google Antigravity's plugin marketplace, connecting the Unity Editor to Antigravity's agentic workflows in one click so developers can request Unity work in plain language.

items.title: Microsoft And Epic Games Suddenly Agree That AI Is Theft
items.excerpt: Kotaku examines how publishers that embraced AI tools are reacting as Claude-driven decompilations, vibe-coded browser ports and PC recomps flood out, with Microsoft and Epic now framing AI copying as theft.

items.title: As EA kills Mass Effect 5, BioWare co-founder slams "weird belief" you can "recreate great games with random people and AI" – "It doesn't work"
items.excerpt: BioWare co-founder Greg Zeschuk criticizes the executive belief that great games can be recreated 'with random people and AI' as EA shutters BioWare.

items.title: Valve veteran says Steam is "overwhelmed with slop and AI crap" in Next Fest event, fears PC becoming more like mobile: "This is the thing that I'm worried about more than anything"
items.excerpt: A Valve veteran says Steam Next Fest is overwhelmed with AI-made slop and worries PC discovery is drifting toward mobile-store dynamics.

items.title: Gaming storefronts are facing a Slop Grenade problem | Opinion
items.excerpt: GamesIndustry.biz opinion piece arguing that gaming storefronts face a 'slop grenade' problem as generative AI floods them with low-effort games.

items.title: "What if Larian had shut down after Divine Divinity?": Star Trek Online exec scorns publishers who close teams like BioWare in favour of "AAA veteran" start-ups and AI "magic beans"
items.excerpt: A Star Trek Online executive criticizes publishers that close experienced teams like BioWare in favour of start-ups and AI 'magic beans'.
